response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM c) AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10
